prompt.es: Escribe un informe de 100 a 150 palabras sobre un rumor de tu barrio.

answer.text: There is a rumour in our neighbourhood about the old cinema on Main Street. Nobody goes inside now, and the windows are always dark. There is said to be a strange light in the basement at night, and some neighbours say they have heard noises. It is rumoured that the owner has left the country because of a secret. The owner is thought to have closed the cinema after a fire many years ago. There are believed to be old films in the basement too. However, nobody has confirmed any of this. There is no proof, and the owner has not answered our questions. For now, it is only a story, and we must be careful before we repeat it.
accepted: There is a rumour in our neighbourhood about the old cinema on Main Street. Nobody goes inside now, and the windows are always dark. There is said to be a strange light in the basement at night, and some neighbours say they have heard noises. It is rumoured that the owner has left the country because of a secret. The owner is thought to have closed the cinema after a fire many years ago. There are believed to be old films in the basement too. However, nobody has confirmed any of this. There is no proof, and the owner has not answered our questions. For now, it is only a story, and we must be careful before we repeat it.

Everybody in my street talks about the abandoned house at the end of the road. There is said to be a light in the basement at night, and there are thought to be secret rooms under the garden. It is rumoured that the owner has sold the house to a stranger. The owner is reported to have heard strange noises before he left. The neighbours say the story is very old, but there is no proof. Nobody has confirmed anything, and nobody has seen the owner this year. Until somebody checks the facts, it is only a rumour, and we should not repeat it as if it were true.

feedback.es: El informe mezcla tres estructuras impersonales y cierra con una nota de cautela para no afirmar de más.

prompt.es: Redacta el informe de la entrevista con los datos del texto (55 a 100 palabras).

answer.text: According to the historian, the legend of the cave is very old. The cave is said to have been a meeting place for the villagers. Some villagers claim that they hear music there at night, and one woman insisted that she had seen a light. I asked whether there was any evidence, and the historian said that there was none. The only source is a local newspaper, so the story remains a legend.
accepted: According to the historian, the legend of the cave is very old. The cave is said to have been a meeting place for the villagers. Some villagers claim that they hear music there at night, and one woman insisted that she had seen a light. I asked whether there was any evidence, and the historian said that there was none. The only source is a local newspaper, so the story remains a legend.

The historian told us that the legend of the cave is very old. It is believed that the cave was a meeting place. Some villagers claimed that they heard music at night, and one of them insisted that he saw a light. I asked if there was any evidence, and the historian admitted that there was none. The source of the story is a local newspaper, so it is only a legend.

feedback.es: El informe separa fuente, rumor, afirmación de los vecinos y pregunta reportada, y no convierte el rumor en un hecho.

origin.text: Fuente: un historiador. Rumor: la cueva fue un lugar de reunión. Afirmación de los vecinos: oyen música por la noche. Pregunta: si había pruebas. Usa una estructura impersonal, dos verbos de reporte y una pregunta reportada.
